provenance.notes: SYNTHETIC. Hand-authored to demonstrate the binding format against the synthetic example-grid network. No camera was surveyed against any road: the observation_area_id values below are placeholders and match no real analysed media. A real binding uses the observation_area_id that Phase 5 actually reports, which for ingested media is 'observation-area:<media_id>'.
